<section id="releaseledger">
<h1>releaseledger</h1>
<p>Project-local release management for coding workflows.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">releaseledger</span></code> stores release records, release-note entries, append-only
events, and deterministic JSON indexes in a project-local or explicitly external
state directory. It also renders reviewable changelog context and final
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">CHANGELOG.md</span></code> sections.</p>

<section id="design-constraints">
<h2>Design constraints</h2>
<p>Releaseledger is standalone. It depends on <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code> for storage and
reference primitives, but it does not import taskledger or inspect taskledger
state. External provenance is represented by explicit global refs such as
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tl:task-0103</span></code>.</p>
</section>
